research_title: 中国省级行政区核心城市铁路网络、降维可视化与聚类分析
current_scope: station dictionary and eight directed pilot queries only; no complete matrix
main_method: prefer timetable-feasible itineraries; coverage and transfer search not yet verified
service_scope: all passenger trains returned by 12306, including conventional and high-speed; inventory does not determine schedule existence
time_definition: elapsed minutes from first train departure to last train arrival, including intermediate waiting when itinerary stage is implemented
terminal_cost_limitation: station-to-station timetable cost, not door-to-door or border-complete passenger journey time
transfer_rule: no zero-cost merging of city stations; same-station and cross-station rules remain to be verified
macau: retain Macau as its own representative node; evaluate railway-plus-access separately after verified access and border costs
taiwan: retain Taipei as representative node; preserve structural disconnection from mainland network separately from query failures
hainan: flag conventional trains potentially using the Yuehai train ferry; verify service and ferry handling before main-scope decision
missing_policy: missing is not unreachable; no mean imputation; no penalty in pilot
future_penalty_definition: P_alpha = alpha * max(observed verified finite off-diagonal times), only after matrix coverage validation; compare reachable subnetwork
notes: Candidate stations and coordinate fields are drafts. This file must not be silently redated. No algorithm matrices may be generated from pilot minima.
